lead.name: Chamara
lead.role: Founder, and the one who draws most of the routes
lead.story: Travedise was founded by Chamara after more than 20 years working inside Sri Lanka’s hospitality and travel industry. That experience shapes every journey: which stays are worth the price, which park to visit and when, and the roads most itineraries miss.

items.title: Fewer places, longer in each
items.body: Four stops done properly beats nine done from the car window. If your dates only allow four, we will say so rather than sell you nine.

items.title: The month decides the coast
items.body: If you are coming in July and you have set your heart on the south, we will tell you to go east instead. Weather is not something to be optimistic about.

items.title: We have slept in the rooms
items.body: Every stay we put you in is one of us has stayed in, or someone on the team has. Where that is not true yet, we say so.

items.title: We will tell you what to skip
items.body: There are famous things here that are not worth your morning. Ask us and you will get a straight answer, not a longer itinerary.
